title: Within the shift modal, Escape first dismisses an open sub-picker before closing the modal itself
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. A shift's detail modal is open.
steps: 1. Open the color picker inside the modal, press Escape, and watch.
2. Open the time picker, press Escape.
3. Start editing a note, press Escape.
4. With nothing open inside the modal, press Escape.
expected: 1. Escape with the color picker open closes only the color picker - the modal stays open.
2. Same for the time picker and the note edit.
3. Escape with no open sub-picker closes the modal itself.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
